description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating two token copies of Ratadrabik and Adrix and Nev with haste.
Put all Ratadrabik and Adrix and Nev tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ratadrabik and Adrix and Nev tokens die, causing a total of ten Ratadrabik triggers, six for the Adrix and Nev tokens and four for the Ratadrabik tokens.
Resolve a Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you control) that are 2/2 Zombies with haste.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining Ratadrabik trigger that makes an Adrix and Nev token.
Resolve a Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Ratadrabik equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you control) that are 2/2 Zombies with haste.
